title: Projects
name: Project name
description: Each project has its own files, sessions, and permissions.
pathHint: The directory ID is permanent. Renaming never changes its path.
instructionsHint: Used by new tasks in this project. Save shared knowledge as project files.
sessionDeleteHint: Delete this session and its messages. Project files are retained. Stop unfinished tasks first.
folderEmpty: This workspace is empty. Upload materials or ask your BOT to create files.
projectOnly: This session uses only this project's files and permissions.
noAgent: Authorize a BOT in project settings to start chatting.
readOnly: This project is archived. You can view history and download files.
grantHint: Access changes stop unfinished tasks in this project. Manage access lets the BOT rename this project from its own chat.
policyHint: Global settings also limit effective permissions. Commands mount only this project's directory. External MCP is not yet available in project sessions.
serverRequired: Project workspaces require an authenticated backend connection.

errors.project_busy: A project task is running. Stop it or try again later.
errors.thread_busy: Stop this session's tasks before deleting it.
errors.project_access_denied: This BOT does not have the required project access.
errors.project_not_found: Project not found or access denied.
errors.project_file_not_found: File not found. Refresh the directory.
errors.project_file_conflict: The file changed. Reopen it before editing or deleting.
errors.project_file_exists: A file with this name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.project_directory_not_empty: Empty the directory before deleting it.
errors.project_path_denied: Links, special files, and paths outside the project are not accessible.
errors.invalid_project_path: Use a project-relative path without parent segments or special characters.
errors.project_text_too_large: This file exceeds the text editor limit (1 MiB). Download it to view.
errors.project_file_not_text: This is not a text file. Download it to view.
errors.file_too_large_or_invalid: The upload exceeds the server limit or was incomplete.
errors.invalid_project_name: Enter a project name of 1–100 characters.
errors.agent_name_taken: This BOT name is already in use.
